title: Murder on the Plantation
summary: The owner of a plantation is found stabbed by a machete, moments before he was going to meet his family and make an announcement.
method: The killer used a secret tunnel to travel between the murder site and where his alibi was confirmed. The discovery of a torch was the clue that there was a tunnel involved.
motive: The killer and his accomplice are twins and the murder was done as revenge for their father’s accidental death. Their father was killed using a piece of machinery on the plantation.
killer: The plantation owner’s new girlfriend and one of his workers.
